policy: Three accepted source states remove three once-loops; their independent stock verification is recorded separately. Complete candidate patches apply independently to base_commit:path. Historical scores concern only the named function, are not semantic proof, and must be recomputed after import.

label: baseline
hypotheses: supplied source baseline

label: direct
hypotheses: Remove only the output-increment do-once wrapper and its obsolete layout comments.

label: counted-for
hypotheses: Use the actual positive bank count as an ordinary for-loop bound and advance each existing cursor once per bank.

label: indexed-banks
hypotheses: Traverse the requested banks by index, keeping each palette base immutable and expressing the shared bank stride directly.

label: typed-bank-cursors
hypotheses: Use pointers to actual sixteen-halfword palette banks, as PaletteResource and the interpolation implementation establish, in an ordinary counted traversal.

label: typed-bank-index
hypotheses: Index actual sixteen-color banks through typed palette arrays instead of byte strides.

label: halfword-cursors
hypotheses: Use the interpolation routine's actual halfword color pointers and advance by its fixed sixteen-color operation.

label: typed-bank-index-named
hypotheses: Give the recovered indexed bank traversal descriptive destination/source/blend/count parameter names.
